title: Hand over: report and close a case
summary: Generate the case report from a template, ask for a review, then close the case with its outcome recorded.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.body:
Handing a case over means a report for its reader and a closed case with its outcome recorded. A case closes only once it has a **reviewer**.

You will practise on a new case for the **IrisInitialClient** test customer; the last step offers to delete it.

steps.title: Open a practice case
steps.body: On the case queue, click **Open a case**.

steps.title: Fill in the case
steps.body: Fill in the case and click **Create**.

fills.label: Short description
fills.value: A case to practise the hand-over on.

steps.title: Open its summary
steps.body: Open case #{caseId}: choose **Switch to newly created case**.

steps.title: Generate the report
steps.body: Open the **...** menu at the top right of the case and click **Generate report**.

steps.title: Pick a template
steps.body: Pick a report template and click **Generate**: the report opens in a new tab. No template in the list? An administrator uploads one under **Settings -> Report Templates**; close the dialog and click Next.

steps.title: Ask for a review
steps.body: In the **...** menu, click **Request review** and pick the reviewer. For practice, pick yourself.

steps.title: Record the outcome and close
steps.body: In the **...** menu, open **Edit Case Details** and click **Edit**. Set the **Outcome** and set the **State** to **Closed**, then click **Save**.

steps.title: Clean up
steps.body: Case #{caseId} is closed with its outcome and reviewer recorded. It was for practice: delete it now, or keep it to look around.
